notes.title: We are Back
notes.content:
New titles in the works and a complete Catalog sale. 

Hey Guys, 

It has been a while but we are back. 

With two titles in the works and a potential third, we are making another run to bring you sequels to the silly games which we all grew to love. 

There's Poop in my Soup 2 - in the works
Frisky Business 2 - in the works


This week we will be running a sale on the whole catalog, check it out below and pick up a game or two if they are missing from your K Bros catalog, there is something for everyone. 

Classics like There's Poop in my Soup, Super Duper Party pooper or Flix and Chill are always a laugh with friends. Albert and Otto was our first game and still very close to our hearts, if you have Albert and Otto then definitely check out Burn it Down as they are very similar yet so different. Tanks vs Aliens and Evil Glitch are awesome for blowing off some steam. 


I have linked all the pages below so you can check them out. 

Thanks for all your support, we look forward to bringing you more games! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/485870/Super_Duper_Party_Pooper/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/588240/Frisky_Business/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/449540/Theres_Poop_In_My_Soup/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/368590/Albert_and_Otto/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/595460/Flix_and_Chill/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/657120/Flix_and_Chill_2_Millennials/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/521630/Toadled/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/657440/Burn_It_Down/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/619890/Evil_Glitch/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/634200/Tanks_vs_Aliens/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/545860/Luke_Sidewalker/


Stay awesome! 

N&N

notes.content:
[b]Thank you everyone for the fantastic support for Super Duper Party Pooper over the past month[/b]
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25193211/925b02b51756e7ed6125634c3ea0e7a44fe6a6bb.png[/img]

AND AS ALWAYS, HAPPY POOPING FOLKS!
